subject: Request: CI approval exceptions and keystore handback for Greenline intake
messages:
From: Michelle Tran <michelle.tran@greenline.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenline.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline intake - CI approvals and keystore handback

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. As part of our SIG intake we need a compact package showing how Redwood handles: code review sampling for production PRs, CI approver exceptions (audit trail), and the keystore handback process when deploying customer-managed keys. Can you provide the artifacts and a short narrative for our assessor?

Specifically, Greenline's security team needs:
- A sampling of code review records for the last 90 days tied to deploys to prod (with redactions)
- The CI approval exception log (who approved, why, PR refs)
- Keystore handback playbook / evidence of a customer HSM handoff (or stub if HSM not used)

We are on a tight assessor timeline next week. If a full bundle is heavy, a small representative set is fine — we only need reproducible traces.

Appreciate it,
Michelle
Greenline Security Intake

---
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Michelle Tran <michelle.tran@greenline.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenline intake - CI approvals and keystore handback

Michelle — thanks for the clarity. We'll assemble a minimal evidence pack and call out redactions. Quick notes up front:

- Code review sampling: we'll export PR-to-deploy mappings for the last 90 days and include code review comments (redacted emails) for 6 production rollouts.
- CI approval exceptions: we maintain an exceptions CSV in the internal audit bucket; I'll pull the relevant rows and provide a short CSV plus timeline comment for each exception.
- Keystore handback: Greenline is using customer-managed keys (KMS) in your VPC. We'll provide the handback narrative and a stub of the keystore export that shows metadata (no private key material).

Irene — can you pull the PR->deploy mapping and the 6 redacted review threads? Jonas — can you export the CI exception rows and add a one-line reason for each?

Michelle — I'm attaching a short runbook draft and a keystore-handback stub to this reply for your intake team. We'll follow up with the CSV and PR samples by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- runbook-delegation.pdf (runbook excerpt, 1 page)
- keystore-handback-stub.txt (metadata-only keystore handback stub)

---
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Michelle Tran <michelle.tran@greenline.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Export: PR->deploy mapping + redacted reviews (Greenline)

Laura / team — I pulled the PR->deploy mapping from our deploy ledger (internal id INT-4582). Attached are:

1) pr_deploy_mapping_6samples.csv (PR id, deploy id, deploy time, service) — 6 rows corresponding to the production rollouts you requested.
2) review_threads_redacted.zip (6 text files) — each file contains the PR description, code review comments, and the deploy link. I redacted reviewer emails and replaced with role tags (e.g., [ENG_REVIEWER]).

Notes on sampling methodology: we prioritized PRs that had post-deploy hotfixes or rollout flags. Each sample includes the CI pipeline run id and the approval gate step.

Jonas — I flagged two PRs that had CI approval exceptions (inline comments). Please add the exception log entries to the CSV.

Michelle — if you need more context on a particular PR's approval chat, let me know which sample and I'll un-redact to the minimal degree necessary under our policy.

--
Irene Choi
Senior Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- pr_deploy_mapping_6samples.csv
- review_threads_redacted.zip
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Michelle Tran <michelle.tran@greenline.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: CI exception rows + keystore handback narrative

Michelle / Laura / Irene — attaching the exception export and the keystore handback narrative we discussed. Summary below.

Summary of the CI approval exceptions (attached: ci-approval-exception-log.csv):
- 3 exceptions in the 90-day window. Each row includes: exception_id, pr_ref, approver_role, approver_name (redacted role-only in public bundle), reason, timestamp, mitigation_actions.
- Examples: emergency rollback patch (approved by SRE lead under oncall escalation), hotfix for data-parsing bug that bypassed normal multi-review approval (approved with documented test-run and smoke checks).

Keystore handback (attached: keystore-handback-stub.txt and runbook-delegation.pdf):
- For customer-managed keys in VPC: we record a keystore metadata export that contains non-secret fields (key id, creation_ts, owner_project, allowed_kms-policies). We never export private key material.
- Our handback playbook: (1) customer initiates HSM transfer request; (2) we establish temporary service account delegation; (3) we export metadata and hand off a signed assertion (sha256) confirming key creation and policy attachments; (4) customer performs on-site KMS verification and acknowledges.
- Attached runbook excerpt includes the signature format and audit verify steps.

Next steps:
- Laura: assemble the final intake bundle (redacted review threads + exception CSV + keystore handback stub + onepager narrative) and share the Docs link for Greenline assessor.
- Michelle: confirm whether the assessor needs whitebox evidence (unredacted) for any specific PR; otherwise we'll provide redacted examples only.

Thanks — I set the attachments to the internal audit bucket and included the Docs link in the related_links field.

Jonas Weber
Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- ci-approval-exception-log.csv
- keystore-handback-stub.txt
- runbook-delegation.pdf
